title: EduGenie — SMARTAPPS by Blue Cloud Softech
description: EduGenie: a workforce management platform from Blue Cloud Softech that brings LMS, ERP and CRM together on one platform.

hero.tagline: Learning, operations and customers, on one platform.
hero.lede: EduGenie brings a learning management system, an ERP and a CRM together, so an institution or a business can train its people, run its operations and manage its customers from one system instead of several.

modules.title: 62 modules across three engines
modules.lede: Learning, institution ERP, business ERP, CRM and CRM operations, plus the innovation programme EduGenie runs with academia and industry.

sections.title: The problem
sections.html:
The problem

What it is there to fix.

Disconnected tools

Separate software for learning, admissions, fees, HR, sales and support means departments work in silos and data is keyed in more than once.

Administrative overload

Manual admissions, attendance, billing and payroll waste staff time and introduce costly errors.

Communication gaps

Staff, students, parents and customers hear different things on different channels, and follow-ups slip through the cracks.

No single view, data at risk

Without one source of truth, decisions rest on guesswork, and sensitive records sit outside any central protection.

One platform, three engines.

Each engine runs on its own or together, on one login, one dashboard and one set of records.

Engine 1 · Learn

sections.title: How it works
sections.html:
How it works

From first enquiry to a served customer.

A sample CRM workflow for a diet and nutrition service, taken from Blue Cloud's CRM workflow material. Sales, accounts, service, HR and IT work from the same records, with time limits on each hand-over.

  1. CaptureLeads arrive automatically from social media, referrals, calls and walk-ins.
  2. DistributeThe team lead shares leads equally across sales executives, filtered by date and country.
  3. ConvertThe executive records plan, quoted and closed amounts, and sends a payment link by WhatsApp or email.
  4. ReconcileAccounts is alerted instantly, matches the payment to the sale, and the invoice goes out automatically.
  5. AssignA dedicated dietitian is assigned to the new client.within 1 hour
  6. ConnectA WhatsApp group is created for the client, followed by an intro call and intake forms.within 2 hours
  7. DeliverA customised diet plan reaches the client, with the next cycle reminded a day in advance.within 24 hours
  8. Follow upCRM staff check progress on day 4 (India) or day 5 (international), and team leads get delay alerts.SLA tracked

Getting started at an institution

Four steps, live within 7 days.

  1. Assessment
  2. Configuration
  3. Training
  4. Go-live

Getting started with BluCRM

Three phases.

  • Setup and configuration: branding, user roles and access, data migration from existing systems.
  • Training and onboarding for every team.
  • Go-live and optimisation: deployment, monitoring, performance tuning and ongoing support.

sections.title: Innovation ecosystem
sections.html:
For universities

Learn, innovate, build, deploy, impact.

For universities and colleges, EduGenie also runs as a Data, AI and IoT innovation ecosystem connecting academia, industry and government. The host institution owns AI labs with GPU infrastructure, which Blue Cloud uses for training and inferencing and pays rent for by compute hours.

Who takes part

Universities, students, industry partners, government and alumni, with Blue Cloud supplying technology, platform and expertise.

From classroom to customer projects

Train, assess, intern, then deploy on live Blue Cloud customer projects in law enforcement, airports, railways, data centres and retail, with impact measured.

How it sustains itself

Compute rent, paid domain programmes, research grants, IP licensing and royalty, consulting and placements.

See the ten innovation modules →

sections.title: Security and integrations
sections.html:
Security and integrations

Secure by design, connected to the tools you use.

Data security

  • Role-based access: control who can see and edit sensitive data, with user-specific dashboards.
  • Encryption: all data encrypted to prevent unauthorised access.
  • Secure cloud storage: scalable hosting with backups and disaster recovery.
  • Secure content: course material delivered through Mobile Device Management.
  • White-label: your logo, colours and design elements across the platform.
